assay_or_perturbation: DLL1 versus DLL4 expression/electroporation; single-cell signaling dynamics; Hes1 and Hey1/HeyL readouts
evidence_summary: DLL1 produced pulsatile signaling that preferentially induced Hes1, whereas DLL4 produced sustained signaling that predominantly induced Hey1 and HeyL; the ligand difference altered neural-crest myogenic differentiation.
limitations: The study is not SCI-specific and does not establish a direct DLL4-to-HES1 edge independent of the composite Notch program.

cell_type_or_model: contusive SCI; endothelial progenitor cells and spinal lesion tissue
assay_or_perturbation: JAG1-positive versus JAG1-deficient progenitor transplantation; Hes5 expression; astrogliosis; locomotor recovery
evidence_summary: JAG1-positive progenitors increased injured-cord Hes5, reactive astrocytes and functional recovery, whereas JAG1-deficient or DLL1-associated controls did not reproduce the same response.
limitations: The study supports pathway/function and ligand selectivity but does not isolate the exact Notch paralog or provide a separate 22A terminal TF-target record.

cell_type_or_model: developing cortical neural stem cells; in vivo N1ICD model
assay_or_perturbation: N1ICD activation; RBPJ ChIP-seq; transcriptome analysis; neurosphere self-renewal assays
evidence_summary: Genome-wide N1ICD/RBPJ analysis identified direct targets in neural stem cells, including Hes1 and Hes5-associated Notch output and broader WNT, SHH and Hippo effectors.
limitations: This establishes the canonical RBPJ target layer in a neural-stem-cell model, not ligand-specific JAG1 or DLL4 occupancy and not injured adult SCI receiver cells.

assay_or_perturbation: DLL4 and BMP9 stimulation; RBPJ siRNA; HEY1/HEY2 qPCR; proliferation assays
evidence_summary: DLL4/Notch and BMP9 cooperatively induced HEY genes and suppressed endothelial proliferation; RBPJ suppression was used to test pathway dependence.
limitations: The cooperative BMP9 context and endothelial model do not establish an SCI-specific DLL4-only path.

cell_type_or_model: Notch1/Notch2 cell-based assays; purified ectodomain and chimeric ligand studies
assay_or_perturbation: DLL1 versus DLL4 binding and activation comparisons; ligand ectodomain swaps
evidence_summary: DLL4 preferentially activated NOTCH1 over NOTCH2, whereas DLL1 activated NOTCH1 and NOTCH2 more similarly; ectodomain features controlled selectivity.
limitations: This supports receptor selectivity rather than a downstream TF target and is not SCI-specific.

cell_type_or_model: purified Notch1 and DLL4 interacting regions
evidence_summary: Structural analysis resolved the direct Notch1-DLL4 interface and showed contributions from Notch1 glycosylation to ligand engagement.
limitations: Structural binding does not establish productive signaling in an SCI receiver cell or a downstream HES/HEY output.
